violated_contract: The self-host product fixture must preserve the complete canonical rendered capabilities and start or explicitly select their actual inference owners. Omitting required model stores must fail admission, never remove LLM/speech contracts or replace embedding inference with deterministic vectors.
canonical_prevention: Require all three prepared native stores, or explicit MiMo credentials plus the BGE-M3 store, before creating fixture state. Preserve the rendered profile unchanged, retain real artifact/capacity/runtime admission, and provision the pinned native models in the existing CI product lane. Regression tests cover missing requirements and unchanged native/MiMo capabilities.
